messages:
olivia: dropped a new micro-spotlight concept for first-run: a round pill near the docs nav that expands into a tiny walkthrough. figma: https://figma.com/file/spotlight-pill-2026 — thoughts?
samir: quick read. i like the low-footprint approach. does it persist across devices or only session?
olivia: goal is cross-device persist until user creates a sample or dismisses. that implies a server-side dismiss flag.
anya: a11y quick notes: collapsed pill must have an accessible name and visible focus state. expanded walkthrough needs aria-live for progress. current comps use 12px caption which is below our min — bump to 14–16px.
dom: implementation constraints: pill expand can reuse popover but focus return + server dismiss need infra work. timeline: client flag + focus states = 1 sprint; server dismiss + telemetry = +1 sprint.
rui: copy nit: CTAs should be verb-first, suggest: "Create sample" (primary) and "Skip for now" (secondary). avoid words like "Get started" for intl clarity.
a11y-bot: automated scan: collapsed pill fails keyboard focus (tabindex missing). expanded content has contrast issue on hint text (ratio 3.1:1). modal role missing on expanded panel.
anya: also request a short post-create announcement with CLI snippet and copy button: `redwood samples run <name>`. ensure the snippet is announced to SR users when copy succeeds.
samir: telemetry names proposal: `onboard.spotlight_impression`, `onboard.spotlight_expand`, `onboard.sample_create`, `onboard.spotlight_dismiss`. include experiment cohort id on impression events.
dom: agree — i'll add experiment hooks once we have the ticket. also note: if we auto-create a repo + key, we must surface what gets created in the microcopy to avoid surprises.
olivia: suggested short CTAs for A/B: "Create sample", "Start tour", "Browse samples". we'll A/B the pill vs a compact strip.
anya: accessibility checklist I'll add: keyboard nav, screen reader expand/announce, focus return, contrast fixes, tooltip keyboard access for API key note.
olivia: next steps: 1) dom to prototype client flag + focusable pill; 2) anya to update comps for contrast and font-size; 3) rui to finalize CTA copy and CLI snippet; 4) samir to add telemetry names to the experiment ticket. I'll file ticket and attach figma.
samir: can we run two 5-minute smoke tests with recent signups to validate first-call flow?
dom: will open PR draft for the client flag and link to the ticket.
anya: attaching quick a11y test checklist to the ticket after comps are updated.
olivia: filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-1042 — pls add comments. thanks! :sparkles:
